title: Lower density code governs the boundary wall between differently coded sites
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c note: Where the subject site is adjacent to a site with a lower density code, the maximum wall length and height of the boundary wall between them is determined by the lower density code.
notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#r1. Table 3.4c note. Needs the adjoining lot's coding per boundary; no per-boundary fact exists, so recorded as judgment.
